req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[4] having kind=negative but heuristic=STC. The rule requires that STC (State Transition Coverage) tests be classified as positive kind, since they exercise valid state transitions. Fix: change test[4] (test_delete_then_redelete_returns_404) heuristic from STC to NEG, which correctly describes a negative scenario (re-deleting a non-existent resource). All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Database contains player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204():
    response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert response.content == b''

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204()

tests.name: test_delete_player_does_not_affect_other_players
preconditions: Database contains players with squadNumber=5 and squadNumber=6
expected: GET /players/squadnumber/6 returns HTTP 200 with correct player data
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_does_not_affect_other_players():
    del_response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert del_response.status_code == 204
    assert del_response.content == b''
    get_response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/6')
    assert get_response.status_code == 200
    data = get_response.json()
    assert data['squadNumber'] == 6
    assert data['firstName'] == 'Pooja'
    assert data['lastName'] == 'Johnson'

test_delete_player_does_not_affect_other_players()
